metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the Gulf of Mexico off southwestern Florida increase in November 21, 2004 compared to October 30, 2004?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the daily 1km-resolution NOAA/NESDIS/GOES3R/GLM chlorophyll-a from the Ocean Color suite (NASA / OBPG served as GOES-3R). We'll target 2004-10-30 (early date) and 2004-11-21 (later date) over the south-western Gulf of Mexico shelf (Point off Naples, FL). 2. Masking strategy: OC data are already atmospheric-corrected; we’ll simply check quality flag BQA as the mask (value 0 = highest quality). No unique cloud mask, just QC-passed pixels. 3. Logic: Compare mean chlorophyll (mg m-3) at the same Point (lat:25.95, lon:-82.6, inside 20km shallow shelf). Compute only if both dates yield at least 10 valid pixels; else C2/C1. Any value <0 or None will be C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1 Geometry & Time loc = ee.Geometry.Point([-82.6, 25.95]) # SW Florida shelf d1 = ee.Date('2004-10-30') d2 = ee.Date('2004-11-21') # 2 Data acquisition def get_chl(date): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GOES/GOES3R/L2A/OC') .filterBounds(loc) .filter(ee.Filter.date(date, date.advance(1,'day')))) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None, None img = col.first() mask = img.select('BQA').eq(0) # highest quality chl = img.select('chlor_a') chl_msk = chl.updateMask(mask) pix = (chl_msk.gt(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=loc.buffer(20000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('chlor_a') .getInfo()) if pix is None or pix <5: # require ≥5 pixels return None, 0 mean = (chl_msk.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=loc.buffer(20000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('chlor_a') .getInfo()) return mean, pix val1, c1 = get_chl(d1) val2, c2 = get_chl(d2) if val1 is None or val2 is None: print("C1: No data for one of the dates.") print("C1") elif c1==0 or c2==0: print("C2: Not enough valid pixels.") print("C2") else: print(f"Oct30 chl: {val1:.2f}, Nov21 chl: {val2:.2f}, pixels: {c1}, {c2}") if val2 > val1: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1 Geometry & Time
loc = ee.Geometry.Point([-82.6, 25.95])  # SW Florida shelf
d1 = ee.Date('2004-10-30')
d2 = ee.Date('2004-11-21')

# 2 Data acquisition
def get_chl(date):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GOES/GOES3R/L2A/OC')
             .filterBounds(loc)
             .filter(ee.Filter.date(date, date.advance(1,'day'))))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0: return None, None
    img = col.first()
    mask = img.select('BQA').eq(0)  # highest quality
    chl = img.select('chlor_a')
    chl_msk = chl.updateMask(mask)
    pix = (chl_msk.gt(0).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                      geometry=loc.buffer(20000),
                                      scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                   .get('chlor_a')
                   .getInfo())
    if pix is None or pix <5:  # require ≥5 pixels
        return None, 0
    mean = (chl_msk.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                 geometry=loc.buffer(20000),
                                 scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                   .get('chlor_a')
                   .getInfo())
    return mean, pix

val1, c1 = get_chl(d1)
val2, c2 = get_chl(d2)

if val1 is None or val2 is None:
    print("C1: No data for one of the dates.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif c1==0 or c2==0:
    print("C2: Not enough valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Oct30 chl: {val1:.2f}, Nov21 chl: {val2:.2f}, pixels: {c1}, {c2}")
    if val2 > val1:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
